_about: D-547: exploited CVEs that affect a product only on some platforms, which no machine-readable feed says (KEV says 'on Linux', the CVE.org record lists the platform 'Linux', NVD's configuration names only the product). Reviewed by hand from the vendor's or the distribution's advisory: 'only' lists the platforms it affects (ids of findings/platform.go platformWords), 'affects' ends 'It affects only …', 'check' is what to look at on a device whose platform is not known, 'source' the advisory, 'ask' the question a person answers when the platform of a device is not known ({device} is its name; D-604: such a CVE is then not a finding but 'Could not be checked'), and 'fixed' (optional) the distribution's first fixed package release per branch of the distribution that 'only' names, read against the package release a person or an agent gives once the platform is known (D-604; apk releases only, checked against Alpine's secdb when added). A device or service whose OS, banner or package database names another platform is ruled out; one that names none keeps the finding with the condition (KF-4, KF-5). Read by modules/findings (platformLimits); checked by TestPlatformLimits_DataIsValid. Before adding an entry, re-check D-620's two paths that are not covered (a forged LLDP Junos claim on a Juniper-made Linux appliance, a forged ARP binding to a Juniper MAC): each entry is a CVE a LAN attacker could hide that way.

CVE-2026-123158.affects: OpenSSH built with musl libc and without PAM, such as Alpine Linux's openssh-server package
CVE-2026-123158.check: check the openssh package version on that device (apk info -v openssh-server): Alpine fixed it in 10.6_p2-r0 (edge), 10.3_p1-r2 (3.24), 10.2_p1-r1 (3.23), 10.0_p1-r11 (3.22) and 9.9_p2-r1 (3.21); until then set PasswordAuthentication no
CVE-2026-123158.ask: Is the OpenSSH on {device} Alpine Linux's openssh-server package, or another build of OpenSSH with musl libc and without PAM?

CVE-2025-2783.affects: Chrome and other Chromium browsers on Windows (a sandbox escape in Mojo's Windows code)
CVE-2025-2783.check: check whether the device runs Windows; Google fixed it in Chrome 134.0.6998.177/.178 for Windows
CVE-2025-2783.ask: Does {device} run Chrome (or another Chromium browser) on Windows?
